SRC-PINNED-CORE-CONFIGURATION-WORLDS.sourceSpan: initConfiguration(EnableCoreCallbacks) copies /configuration.txt, constructs ConfigurationNode and calls load() at lines 398-418; it then calls HDBlockModels.loadModels and TexturePack.loadTextureMapping. The same method copies /worlds.txt and calls world_config.load() at lines 609-615.

SRC-PINNED-LEGACY-TERRAIN-ATLAS-TRACE.sourceSpan: loadTerrain(boolean) walks per-texture files derived from getRPFileName/terrain_rp_map (lines 280-362, 1139 onward); the packaged terrain.png row is not the single-image path used by that loop. P-001 expressly requires this exact atlas trace before exclusion.

SRC-PINNED-TEXTUREPACK-PACK-METADATA-LOO.sourceSpan: TexturePack constructor opens the exact literal pack.mcmeta at line 639. Forge adapter openResource resolves null-modid requests through mod classloaders; module-specific source anchors are recorded per pack.mcmeta row. The resource winner remains planned evidence.

SRC-PINNED-PLATFORM-PERMISSIONS-EXAMPLE-.sourceSpan: The callee copies the requested classpath resource to the supplied data-folder file. Each platform permissions row also cites its exact pinned DynmapPlugin.java callsite anchor.

PLAN-P001-LEGACY-TERRAIN-ATLAS-SCOPE.sourceSpan: Per-resource requirement to trace the packaged legacy terrain atlas and compatibility branches before exclusion; this is a scheduled disposition, not global closure.

PLAN-P001-LEGACY-PLATFORM-VERSION-SCOPE.sourceSpan: The pinned product version policy is Minecraft 1.14+; this planned exclusion is limited to the Forge 1.12.2 packaged configuration resource.

entries.exclusionRationale: For this exact packaged terrain.png row, the pinned TexturePack terrain path walks mapped individual texture files through getRPFileName/terrain_rp_map rather than opening the packaged atlas as a single image. This excludes only this atlas resource; its legacy parser/mappings remain separately owned and global closure is pending. License remains unverified.
